text:
Liam Ross: quick sync: launching the OSS mini-kit (code samples + tiny refapp). need decisions on launch post angle, benchmark callouts, webinar format, and lead routing. :spiral_calendar:
Priya Nair: i'm thinking three-pronged: blog post (how-to + tl;dr benchmark), short webinar (20m demo + 10m q&a), and a tiered email drip for signups.
Marco Ruiz: for benchmarks, keep it developer-facing: single endpoint latency, cold vs warm cache, and a simple cost comparison vs raw GPU hosting. no enterprise SLAs in copy.
Jules Tran: messaging test idea: version A = "Ship the mini-kit in 10 minutes" (focus quickstart). version B = "See our latency & cost numbers in real apps" (focus bench).
Liam Ross: good. for the blog hero stat we can say: "mini-kit boots in < 1 minute locally; typical median token latency 80-120ms on our quantized runtime" — but we should mark as "example results" and link to the full bench data.
Marco Ruiz: agree — include an obvious caveat: "results vary by model, hardware, and prompt length". add a link to raw bench json: https://git.redwood/oss/minikit/bench/2026-03-20.json
marketing-bot: Reminder: existing community webinar template is `webinar/community-mini-kit-v2` and has GA tracking built in.
Priya Nair: webinar format: 20m demo (Jules) + 15m benchmark walkthrough (Marco) + 10m live q&a. can we record separate segments so we can repurpose clips?
Jules Tran: yes. i'll record the demo as a standalone clip. we'll also capture 2 short soundbites for social.
Liam Ross: inbound routing: prefer HubSpot mapping by primary interest field on signup form: interest=quickstart or interest=bench. quickstart -> nurture_list_4103 -> marketing drip. bench -> infra_interest_list_4104 -> assign to ML content series + tag company_size.
Marco Ruiz: webhook payload sample we'll accept from the landing page: { "email": "...", "interest": "bench", "company": "...", "utm_source": "mailchimp", "utm_campaign": "oss_minikit_launch" }
Priya Nair: set utm_content to the variant: utm_content=msgA or msgB so analytics ties messaging to conversions. also add `experiment=oss_minikit_msg_v1` param on the post-click link.
marketing-bot: Note: landing template staging path `/staging/landing/oss-minikit-v1` will be provisioned at 09:00 PT.
Jules Tran: email variants: short dev-first subject + example CTA for msgA: "Run the mini-kit in 10 minutes". msgB subject: "Mini-kit benchmarks: latency, cost, and real-world tips". include a docs-first CTA and a "try now" CTA.
Liam Ross: success metrics: primary = new GitHub stars + repo clones within 7 days. secondary = webinar-to-trial conversion and demo requests. we should tag GitHub flows with `utm_campaign=oss_minikit_launch` on repo links.
Marco Ruiz: analytics: assign event `oss_minikit_signup` and include `interest`, `experiment`, `variant`, `company_size` in payload. that makes downstream joins easier.
Priya Nair: timeline: draft blog + landing + two email variants by Thu EOD. webinar slots: pick two times for APAC and NA. Marco/Jules confirm slides + bench figures by Wed.
Liam Ross: sounds good. i'll assemble the playbook doc and share a short checklist here when ready. ping me if you want to pair on the landing. :rocket:
